sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: Five robbers armed with knives boarded a ship underway and entered the engine room. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the robbers escaped with the stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to the Singapore VTIS and Marine Police. Coast Guard boarded the ship for investigation.
